name: 67202 · Wichita, KS
findings: ZIP 67202 (Wichita) has 143 nonprofit organizations. 54 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 39 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 67202 (Wichita) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
83% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 67202 (Wichita) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 10.7 times the typical level).
